description: An MCP server that applies to jobs inside a human-granted written policy: target roles, salary floor, locations, company allowlist + blocklist, daily cap, approval threshold, expiry and a kill switch. Discovery is live against the public Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable JSON feeds. Review-first by design: matches land as prepared applications with a tailored resume that re-orders verbatim real experience only — every tailoring ships with a machine-verifiable diff proving zero invented facts — and every grant, preparation, approval, refusal and submission emits a receipt into an append-only, hash-chained ledger. v0.1 submission is DRY-RUN ONLY: the Greenhouse payload is built, validated and recorded, and nothing is transmitted to any employer.
